Post 1
📉 ASX 200 shed 174.90pts or 1.99% to 8,614.40 — a fresh 50-day low. Rare earths led the carnage, down double digits. The index is now negative for 2026, off 1.15% YTD. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔴 No sector spared. Energy worst at -3.03%, A-REITs -2.51%, Healthcare -2.49%. Only IT held ground, off just -0.62%. Rate-sensitive and commodity sectors took the heaviest blows. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 3
⛏️ LTR cratered 15.05% to AUD 0.790. LYC fell 8.60% to AUD 12.640. Rare earths under serious pressure — both stocks among the ASX 200's worst. #ASX #mining #rareearths

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,028.17/oz. Silver AUD 87.61/oz. Metals priced in AUD with AUDUSD at 0.6946. Elevated gold offers miners a cushion — but sentiment today overwhelmed it. #gold #silver #commodities #ASX

Post 5
Index sits at a 50-day low. Watch whether 8,600 holds. If US payrolls disappoint overnight, that floor gets tested hard. Bulls or bears — where does ASX close the week? #ASX #ausbiz #macro
